prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering, isometric view from front-below-side, of twin under-deck tuned mass damper on HSFG-clamped cross-beam at work under a footbridge midspan. On a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product-shot lighting, show a short clean-cut segment of bridge: horizontal deck soffit slab on top cut off at backdrop, two vertical steel girder webs left and right supporting it. A transverse steel cross-beam spans between the girder webs just below the soffit, clamped at both ends with rows of dark HSFG bolt sets. Hanging from the center of the beam are two identical black steel block masses side by side, each about knee-height, each suspended by a vertical steel coil spring and a parallel stainless viscous damper cylinder. Small caged black elastomer travel stops with a visible gap sit beside the masses. A tiny deck accelerometer box sits on top of the deck slab at midspan. Include one standing adult person on the backdrop beside the assembly for true scale of the 3 m span, no other people or objects. Show operating moment with beam moving with bridge and masses lagging slightly opposite, springs and dampers visibly stroked. Real materials, sharp detail, mechanism readable, relative proportions true: beam longest, masses compact blocks, springs and dampers slender verticals, bolts small. For each focus part draw a short callout with thin leader line to its plain name on a small light tag placed in empty space: Transverse Cross Beam, Tuned Mass, Coil Spring Suspension, Viscous Damper, Clamp Bolt Set, Elastomer Travel Stop, Deck Accelerometer. Clean legible callouts, no other text, no numbers, no margins or scale bars.
must_not: deck-top machinery cabinets or control rooms
room interiors, landscapes, skies or furniture
generic abstract diagrams or colored sketch overlays
changes_from_previous: Initial version - no previous rounds. First photorealistic isometric rendering built directly from mechanism sketches and solution embodiment.

visual_plan.view: isometric product shot from front-below-side showing under-deck assembly, girder segment and deck patch on seamless light-grey backdrop
visual_plan.spatial_layout: isometric from below-side: deck slab horizontal on top, girders vertical left and right, cross-beam transverse between girders below soffit, two masses centered under beam side-by-side, springs and dampers vertical between beam and masses, bolt sets at beam-to-girder ends, stops flanking masses, accelerometer centered on deck top, adult figure standing to right for scale
visual_plan.operating_moment: resonant crowd excitation moment: girders and cross-beam oscillating vertically, twin masses displaced opposite to beam with 49 mm-scale stroke visible, dampers extending, stops ungaged with clear gap, accelerometer logging
visual_plan.transfer_path: vibration: main girders to transverse cross-beam to twin masses via springs, dissipated in viscous dampers as heat; measured: midspan accelerometer to comfort band verdict
visual_plan.interactions: cross-beam clamped to both girder webs by bolt friction; springs and dampers hang vertically from beam to top of each mass; masses move relative to beam stretching springs and stroking dampers; travel stops stand clear with gap to catch overtravel; accelerometer bolted to deck senses deck motion
avoid: no room, landscape, sky, furniture, tools or clutter
no welded connections, no single mass, no deck-top equipment
no sketch colors, circles or line styles as materials
no extra text, numbers, margins or scale bars beyond light-tag callouts

focus_parts.purpose: carries both damper units and moves with bridge
converts bridge motion into relative travel
clamps beam to girders by friction
logs vertical acceleration for comfort verdict
